body: > [!IMPORTANT] > Removing the Library's window drop handling likely lets a dropped video navigate the whole Electron window away from the app. Recent exports also labels editor exports as destination copies. **Reviewed changes** I reviewed the full diff: the new Export screen and rail entry, the Prepare removal, the routing and redirects, the Email destination, the Library cleanup, and the i18n changes. - **Export screen** — `pages/export/*` replaces `pages/prepare/*` with a fixed header, a stage that scrolls on its own, a fixed destination row, and document-level Enter / ←→ handling. - **Routes** — adds `/export/:assetId` and `/export`. Legacy `/prepare*` URLs redirect there and keep `?to=`. `preparePath` / `prepareNewPath` now return Export URLs. - **Email destination** — a new `DestinationId` that uses chat's `balanced` preset. `usePrepareCopy` accepts a `destination` override so the cards can name it. - **Rail** — a new EXPORT entry sits under Editor. The copy badge moves there from Library and now also counts the export that is running. - **Library** — the drop strip, the Import / Prepare buttons and the window-wide `useFileDrop` are removed, and `ImportDropZone` is deleted.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/6?action=fix&review_id=5730802385) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/6?action=fix-approved&review_id=5730802385) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/actions/runs/41362578203/job/125015904071) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
